description: This file contains unit tests for gyp-mode, specifically testing syntax highlighting (fontification) of gyp files within Emacs. It defines test cases, utilities for reading and fontifying files, and compares against golden samples to ensure correctness.

methods.name: fontify
methods.description: Reads a filename, applies gyp-mode for syntax coloring, and returns fontified content as string.

methods.name: read-golden-sample
methods.description: Reads a golden sample file (with .fontified extension) and deserializes its content.

methods.name: equivalent-face
methods.description: Normalizes certain face types for comparison purposes.

methods.name: text-face-properties
methods.description: Extracts text face properties from a string for comparison.

methods.name: create-golden-sample
methods.description: Generates a golden sample file from fontified version of a given filename.

methods.name: create-golden-samples
methods.description: Regenerates all golden samples for the listed test data files.
